about_the_game:
Get ready to hide (or seek) in style with the Goofy Skins Pack for your favorite hide-and-seek game! This DLC brings two wacky new characters to the mix:

🕺 Sam – Just a regular guy... or is he? With his unassuming look and oddly confident stance, Sam is the ultimate wildcard in the game of hide and seek.

🍌 BananaMan – Half monkey, half superhero, all ridiculous. With his bright colors and heroic pose, blending in might not be his strong suit—but style definitely is.

Whether you're sneaking around or chasing down your friends, these silly skins add a fun twist to the classic game. Grab the SamsSkinsPack and let the hiding (and seeking) begin!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Ever wanted to be look cooler than all your friends? Well look no further than Sam's skin pack! Included is a bananaMan skin and a SamMan skin. Both usable in all shenaniganza game modes!
